text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day has finally arrived for the
Hopeful
Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's today's race again? The Heartful
Gretel? I
heard it's the first race ever
held underwater.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Finally, the day I can show the
world my
stunning butterfly stroke has
come!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, Pacific Ocean! I'll see you
as soon
as I get past the Japan Trench!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's definitely excited for the wrong
thing, but
at least she's excited to race
in general!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Will do! Nothing can stop me, much less
a measly
oceanic trench or two!
